code_summary: Trains one independent ConvRec model per category, using 96-dimensional tied item embeddings, four residual causal convolution blocks with dilations 1/2/4/8, and jointly learned exponentially decayed prefix memory fused through a gate. Uses balanced sampled BCE with 256 shared uniform negatives, random prefix windows, AdamW, warmup/cosine learning-rate decay, and validation checkpoint selection. The exported predictor routes each category to exactly one selected checkpoint, with strict loading and score verification. Failures save a full traceback under working/training_error.log.
